title: pcapng: add support for custom blocks
description:
This patch adds support for pcapng custom blocks, which are not
know by the reader. In particular, they are also written when
the block type requires it.

notes.body:
Just to give some context: adding support for generic custom options is next on my agenda. The goal is to add support for TCP related custom options and blocks, which carry information about the state of the TCP stack and events other than sending and receiving packets. This is called TCP black box logs and available in FreeBSD. It was developed by Netflix and is therefore using the Netflix PEN.

But before adding support for then known custom options and blocks, I wanted to add support for unknown ones.
